errors.what: Initial commands failed (No such file or directory) because the agent thread resets cwd between bash calls, breaking the prompt's relative paths
errors.recovered_by: Resolved repo root via git rev-parse and used absolute paths for all subsequent commands

problems_and_friction: Bash cwd resets between calls in the agent thread, so the prompt's relative paths failed; switching to absolute paths anchored at the repo root resolved it. The patch-data merge applied cleanly with no re-transcription of prior analysts' data.
context_understood: I risk-weighted the Zoho vs HubSpot finalists, merge-patching role-namespaced risk fields (migration data quality top/High, Zoho maturity Medium, HubSpot maturity Low) into the data-only Brightline CRM doc for the lead partner to synthesise at hop 12.
